decks.title: Evening Spark
decks.subtitle: Warm magnetism, lingering glances & playful tension

cards.text: Tell me one tiny, unintentional thing I do that still makes you want to pull me closer.
Hold steady eye contact in complete silence for 45 seconds—no looking away. Whoever breaks first owes a whispered confession.
What was the exact moment you knew the pull between us was different from anyone else?
Put on a slow song that feels like us—interlace your fingers and sway together for the first 20 seconds.
What quiet everyday moment with me makes your pulse soften the second it happens?
Which night we spent together still replays in your head like a favorite midnight scene?
Describe the chemistry between us in three words—then let your partner kiss you if they agree.
When you're exhausted at the end of a long day, what touch or gesture from me melts your tension fastest?
Flirt with your partner like it's the night we first met—30 seconds on the clock, and they decide if you won them over.
What secret first impression did you have of me that you were too shy to admit back then?
Pull your partner in for a 30-second slow dance with no music—hands stay on their waist, foreheads almost touching, no laughing allowed.
Invent a teasing secret nickname for your partner—you have to whisper it every time you speak to them tonight.
In a low, cinematic voice, spend 30 seconds describing your partner as the irresistible lead of a late-night romance.
If we could vanish to a hidden hotel balcony anywhere in the world tonight, where are we pouring our drinks?
Hand over tonight's soundtrack and drink order to your partner—no vetoes allowed.
Name two bold date nights we've only talked about—pick one tonight and promise a date on the calendar.
Close your eyes and picture our next reunion—what is the very first second you see?
Read aloud a saved text or note from me that still gives you butterflies.
Leave a 30-second low-voiced midnight voicemail as if you're calling from a rain-soaked hotel room.
When we're apart, which tiny sensory detail about me—my voice, scent, or laugh—hits you out of nowhere?
Script our next 24 hours together in three scenes: slow morning, stolen afternoon, and after midnight.
What is one lingering, daring text you typed out to me recently—then deleted before hitting send?
Drop your voice to a quiet whisper and paint our dream weekend getaway for 45 seconds—slowly, detail by detail.
The moment the door clicks shut behind us next time we meet, what do you want me to do first?

decks.title: After Dark
decks.subtitle: Slow tension, breathless pauses & velvet dares (VIP)

cards.text: Lean in until your breath brushes their ear—without touching—and whisper the exact thing you want them to do to you later tonight.
What look, scent, or small movement of mine makes it impossible for you to keep your hands to yourself?
Let your hands linger on your partner's neck and shoulders for 45 seconds, slowly naming three things that draw you to them.
Move close enough to feel each other's breath for 30 seconds—interlace your fingers, hold eye contact, and resist kissing until the timer ends.
What subtle cue from me instantly shifts an ordinary night into something electric between us?
Without saying a word, trace the inside of your partner's wrist and palm with one fingertip for 30 seconds while watching their eyes.
Clink glasses without breaking eye contact, take a slow sip, and admit a bold thought you've been hiding tonight.
Do you melt faster for slow, agonizing anticipation or an unexpected kiss that catches you off guard?
Have your partner close their eyes and surrender the lead for 60 seconds: glide your fingertips along their collarbone, neck, or wrist and let them whisper how each pause feels.
If we checked into a velvet-lit boutique hotel under fake names tonight, what playful roles would we step into?
For 45 seconds, your partner isn't allowed to move a muscle while you leave slow, lingering kisses anywhere except their lips—stopping just short of where they want you most.
Play strangers locked in eye contact across a midnight cocktail bar—you have 60 seconds to cross the room and convince them to leave with you.
Lean in until your lips are a whisper apart, freeze for five slow heartbeats, then let your partner decide how the kiss begins.
Paint your ideal late-night atmosphere—lighting, music, pace, and the exact way you want to be pulled close.
Eyes closed for 45 seconds: guide your partner's hands around you and pull them into a breathless slow sway to a tune only you hum.
Claim a Velvet Privilege: whisper one bold, romantic wish for later tonight—your partner seals the promise with a slow kiss.

decks.title: Desire Match
decks.subtitle: Swipe blindly — only ideas you BOTH crave are revealed

cards.text: Phones locked away, candlelight dimmed low, slow playlist, and a late dinner made just for two.
A mystery date night where one partner plans every stop and the other simply surrenders to the surprise.
Unrushed 10-minute warm oil shoulder and back massages—no phones, no rush, just slow hands.
Dim every lamp in the living room and slow dance barefoot in loungewear to midnight jazz.
Write sealed confession notes about what draws you to each other and read them softly by bedside light.
A 60-second slow-motion kiss tease—pull back an inch every 10 seconds to build the tension.
Dress to impress, meet separately at a cocktail lounge, and flirt like strangers who can't resist each other.
Mix signature midnight cocktails for each other—every sip unlocks a bolder truth.
Silk blindfold sensory tease: guess three slow touches, scents, or sweet tastes chosen by your partner.
15 minutes as 'Tonight's Director': one partner whispers gentle, teasing requests while the other gladly follows.
